CRITICAL COMPOSITION: wide horizontal 16:9 relaxed WAIST-UP portrait. The ENTIRE headwear, any plume, all hair, beard and both shoulders must fit comfortably within the frame. Highest hat/hair point near y=20 percent; upper 15 percent only continuous softly blurred background. Pull camera BACK enough; never crop helmet/hair or make a tight headshot.
Use case: historical-scene / identity-preserve. Finished HD portrait for the established original Three Kingdoms game series. The single input is the original 24x24 native portrait of 张昭, game period 1, zero-based PersonID 152. It is ONLY identity guidance: preserve visible facial proportions, apparent age, native eyes/brows/nose, amount of facial hair, headwear shape and facing direction. A mature dignified scholarly official preserving the native high forehead, defined brow and cheek lines, native moustache and beard and modest cloth headwear silhouette. Layered warm-gray and muted brown late-Han robes, quiet composed expression, no military armor.
Restrained cinematic historical realism, natural skin texture, believable late-Han cloth, leather and metal, soft natural side daylight, muted earthy colors, quiet softly defocused courtyard background with no other people and no banners or calligraphy. A distinct recognizable person, not a generic cloned actor. Person centered horizontally, natural human proportions. Opaque finished PNG.
Never display the tiny native input as an inset, corner picture, stamp, sprite, overlay or collage. No text, Chinese characters, names, watermark, signature, logo, border, UI, extra people, modern objects, fantasy glow, anime or enlarged pixel art. True original high-resolution realistic artwork.
